column1: # E00-S13 / ADR §9.9 component freeze. Names Android stores or binds to, taken from the released Flutter app
# sources under android/app/src/main/kotlin). ComponentFreezeTest checks every line against the shipped (same-package
# 'switch' release) manifest and the native Kotlin sources. Never edit a line to make the test pass: a name here that
# changes breaks widgets, tiles, shortcuts, alarms, scheduled work or notification settings on the update.
# Columns: kind<TAB>name<TAB>detail. Placeholders in braces stand for any value.
# component: <manifest tag>:<FQCN>; detail lists intent actions it must still declare.
# widget: an app-widget provider (APPWIDGET_UPDATE + android.appwidget.provider meta-data). Placed widgets name it.
# tile: a Quick Settings tile service (BIND_QUICK_SETTINGS_TILE + QS_TILE). Added tiles name it.
# meta: application meta-data the widget code reads.
# shortcut: a static launcher shortcut id (pinned copies keep the id); it must open MainActivity.
# scheme: a deep link MainActivity's VIEW filter accepts.
# channel: a notification channel id (the person's sound/importance/off choices live under it). The Flutter
# QA-only channel bb9_qa_producer is not part of the shipped app and is left out.
# worker: a WorkManager worker class name (WorkManager stores it with every enqueued request).
# work-name / work-tag: unique-work names and tags the Flutter app enqueued; the native app must still name them
# (to keep, replace or cancel that work).
# authority: a FileProvider authority. The Flutter app declared no FileProvider of its own; the native one is frozen
# from its first release so URIs already granted to other apps keep resolving, and it follows the application id.
